searchText: so you already have 5718 post merge in state merged in? Could we have 5718 merged in asap and add tests later? > 5718 post merge in state merged what are you saying? 😄 `SLOT_DURATION_MS_HEZE` is added not `SLOT_DURATION_MS_8198` but yes, 8198 is backward compatible, it passes all current spec tests if you don't change slot times yes lodestar has this all of our tooling expects 8198 for now as the pr 5718 is not yet merged in once 5718 is merged we can change all our tooling to take the ms_heze version well the problem then is if you change `SLOT_DURATION_MS_HEZE` to anything other than 12 seconds then stf changes and clients may disagree on kurtosis since the code paths are not spec tested We gonna keep 12s for the the next devnet tho? We can still independently test different clients with alternative slot time yes that's what we agreed to STF changes can come in with the follow up pr/devnet right so I see no rush in adding all the tests to 5718, but merging in 5718 would enable us to have all the tooling prepared and would enable us to begin testing with shorter slots with individual clients
